secondary_entity_en: Ministry of Public Works and Transport
routing_notes: Municipalities handle local streets and sidewalks. MPWT regional road units handle public/national roads, bridges, snow/rainwater road maintenance, obstacles, and citizen road complaints. CDR is an escalation/project owner only for active CDR worksites, reconstruction zones, or capital infrastructure projects. If GPS/road class is ambiguous, route to HITL.

Route to the regional water establishment determined by GPS governorate: Beirut + Mount Lebanon → BMLWE (1700); North Lebanon + Akkar → NLWE (1700); South Lebanon + Nabatieh → SLWE (1700); Bekaa + Baalbek-Hermel → BWE. Runtime resolution via RWA_DYNAMIC in routing_rules + entity_service_area_mapping (SAM-WATER-001 to SAM-WATER-004). Internal plumbing/private wells are NOT within scope.

EDL handles the national electricity grid. However many areas rely on private generator operators (moualid) for supplemental power, which are not public entities. HITL always required to confirm whether the fault is EDL grid, local distributor, or private generator. Do not auto-route electricity complaints.

Routine collection and street cleaning are municipal. Hazardous, medical, chemical, burning, or illegal dumping cases require MOE as the environment/public-health authority with municipality as local co-entity and HITL. CDR handles waste only at reconstruction or infrastructure project sites.

Civil Defense (Défense Civile) for emergency flood response and rescue. Municipality for street-level drainage blockages and maintenance. CDR for failures in national drainage infrastructure. Civil Defense is always notified first; municipality handles follow-up drainage repair.

HITL always required for safety complaints. ISF for public safety incidents and criminal matters. Civil Defense for structural hazards, fire risk, and collapse risk. Never auto-route safety complaints. Human reviewer confirms entity and urgency before dispatch.

Fixed landline, DSL, VDSL, and Ogero fiber faults route to Ogero. Mobile network outages route to mobile operator (Alfa/Touch). Billing disputes or service quality violations escalated beyond operator route to TRA (hotline 1739). Current CedarFix classifiers may not yet support TELECOM, so keep HITL=true until the sector is implemented.

Sector unclear. Route to human review without prediction. Reviewer assigns sector and entity manually. Every OTHER complaint corrected by a reviewer becomes a training label for the IEP-1 issue-type classifier.

EDZ exception: Zahle city and Zahle district in Bekaa hold an EDZ concession. EDL is NOT the correct entity for Zahle electricity complaints. HITL required until GPS/address confirms Zahle district vs rest of Bekaa. Use entity_service_area_mapping SAM-ELEC-002 for lookup.
